newsitem.title: USA: Woodhead says order backlog increases.
newsitem.headline: Woodhead says order backlog increases.

text.p: Woodhead Industries Inc said order backlog rose to $10.4 million for the quarter just ended, up 21 percent from $8.6 million at the end of fiscal 1996.
"We are therefore optimistic that Woodhead Industries will produce another year of solid growth for its shareholders," said chief executive Mark DeWinter.

The maker of electrical devices, copper and fiber optic cable assemblies, motion control products, and ergonomic workstations on Thursday reported profits for the first quarter ended December 28 of $0.24 per share, up 20 percent from the year-ago period.
